name: shipped-not-measured
description: Everything shipped, nothing measured. A vanity metric on the goal.
expectations: Flags that outcome-1 has shipped items but nothing in measuring and no learning loop (shipped-not-learning)
Flags 'Total registered users' on goal-1 as a vanity metric or as disconnected from business value (weak-goal-metric or impact-disconnected-goal)
Suggests moving shipped work to measuring or defining what to track, as a possibility rather than an order
Does not say the team is slow or that they shipped too little

outcomes.behaviorChange: From sporadic logging to a weekly habit
